episodes.title: What is computer programming?
episodes.description: This episode takes us through the main functions of a computer and some of the core concepts in the programming process.

episodes.title: Computer Memory & Variables
episodes.description: Explore systems of computer memory and how variables let programs store and use information.

episodes.title: Manipulating Data with Expressions
episodes.description: Use expressions as the basic tools for processing data and getting computers to perform useful calculations.

episodes.title: Basic Output & Formatting
episodes.description: Explore text output and formatting as a first step toward producing useful results from Java programs.

episodes.title: Programs that Gather Input
episodes.description: In this episode, we learn how to communicate with our digital devices via standard input and Scanner objects.

episodes.title: Using Java to Create a Simple Program
episodes.description: Combine variables, expressions, input, and printed output to build complete Java programs.

episodes.title: If-Else Statements and Decision Trees
episodes.description: Examine how computer programs make decisions using information and specified criteria.

episodes.title: Conditional Statements & Yes/No Questions
episodes.description: Explore how conditional logic lets programs handle different scenarios and make decisions.

episodes.title: Using Methods to Make Your Life Easier
episodes.description: Use methods to divide complex programming problems into simpler parts.

episodes.title: How to Fix Programming Errors
episodes.description: Identify and debug Java problems, from syntax mistakes to exceptions that occur while a program runs.

episodes.title: Of Mice and Methods…and If/Else Statements
episodes.description: Combine Java methods and conditional logic to build more capable programs.

episodes.title: What is Recursion?
episodes.description: As weird as it sounds, recursion can actually help keep our code readable, manageable and easier to change down the line!

episodes.title: Method Madness: Nesting & Call Stacks
episodes.description: Use a cafe example to explore Java methods and the behind-the-scenes organization of data during method calls.

episodes.title: The Repetitive Power of While Loops
episodes.description: Use while loops and conditional statements to repeat tasks and stop flexibly when a condition is met.

episodes.title: For Loops vs. While Loops
episodes.description: Compare while loops with for loops and choose an approach based on whether the number of repetitions is known.

episodes.title: Modeling Mice With For Loops in Java
episodes.description: Apply for loops in Java to model radioactive mice and simulate movement using Brownian motion.

episodes.title: How to Clean Up Your Code
episodes.description: Learn strategies for writing readable code and collaborating effectively with other programmers.

episodes.title: Organize Your Data with an ArrayList
episodes.description: Store and retrieve data with ArrayLists, then combine lists with loops to process large collections efficiently.

episodes.title: Computer Memory & Reference Types
episodes.description: Explore how Java variables and method calls use memory, including how references and values are stored and updated.

episodes.title: Is my Algorithm Broken?
episodes.description: Clarify what algorithms are and explore how human bias can become algorithmic bias with ethical consequences.

episodes.title: Teaching a Computer to Read & Write Files
episodes.description: In this episode, we’ll learn about how our computers read and write files!

episodes.title: The Magic of Bubble Sort
episodes.description: Explore bubble sort as a way to organize ArrayLists, including the algorithm’s advantages and limitations.

episodes.title: What’s the point of a Java Class?
episodes.description: Use Java classes to group related information containing different data types.

episodes.title: Herding Cats with Java Encapsulation
episodes.description: Combine instance variables and methods inside Java classes to model data and behavior together.

episodes.title: Object Oriented Programming
episodes.description: Explore encapsulation and object-oriented programming techniques that help protect a program’s data.

episodes.title: Simulating Race Cars with OOP
episodes.description: Plan classes and write Java code for an object-oriented simulation of racing cars.

episodes.title: Chaining Class Constructors Is Like Lego
episodes.description: Combine Java classes and chained constructors to model complex interactions in a monster-fighting game.

episodes.title: Will they live? Radioactive Mouse Finale
episodes.description: Build an object-oriented radioactive-mouse simulation in Java and export the resulting data to a CSV file.
